description_en: Creates a model service that enables AI functions to invoke models and supports the creation of two types of models: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio models and Hologres AI nodes. If you use Hologres AI, you must separately purchase AI node resources
description_zh: 创建模型服务，支持AI function调用模型。支持创建两类模型：1）阿里云百炼模型；2）Hologres AI节点。如果是Hologres AI，需要另外购买AI节点资源
kebab_example: aliyun hologram create-model-service --instance-id hgpostcn-cn-lbj335xxxx --model-type qwen3.5-plus --model-service-name my_model --api-version 2022-06-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateModelService

parameters.help_en: The API key for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio. Log on to the Model Studio console or use the API to obtain the key. This parameter is required only for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio models
parameters.help_zh: 百炼API Key，请登陆百炼控制台或通过API获取。此参数仅百炼模型需要
parameters.name: api_key

parameters.help_en: The CPU specifications. This parameter is required only for Hologres AI nodes
parameters.help_zh: CPU，此参数仅Hologres AI节点需要
parameters.name: cpu

parameters.help_en: The GPU specifications. This parameter is required only for Hologres AI nodes
parameters.help_zh: GPU规格，此参数仅Hologres AI节点需要
parameters.name: gpu

parameters.help_en: The GPU memory specifications. This parameter is required only for Hologres AI nodes
parameters.help_zh: GPU 内存规格，此参数仅 Hologres AI 节点需要
parameters.name: gpu_memory

parameters.help_en: The memory specifications. This parameter is required only for Hologres AI nodes
parameters.help_zh: 内存规格，此参数仅Hologres AI节点需要
parameters.name: memory

parameters.help_en: The model parameters. Refer to the default parameters returned by ListModelCatalog. You can pass the parameters directly or modify them as needed before passing. This parameter is required only for Alibaba Cloud Model Studio models
parameters.help_zh: 模型参数，请参考ListModelCatalog返回的默认参数，直接传入，有必要则修改后再传入。此参数仅百炼模型需要
parameters.name: model_params

parameters.help_en: The model name. To query Alibaba Cloud Model Studio models, call ListModelCatalog. To query Hologres AI nodes, call GetAvailableModelsResource
parameters.help_zh: 模型名称。如果是百炼模型，请调用ListModelCatalog查询；如果是Hologres AI节点，请调用GetAvailableModelsResource查询
parameters.name: model_type

parameters.help_zh: 底层模型提供方。取值：holo_bailian（阿里云百炼集成模型，与 ListModelCatalog 返回的 provider 一致）、hologres（Hologres AI 节点）。百炼集成模型建议使用 holo_bailian
parameters.name: provider

parameters.help_en: The number of service replicas. This parameter is required only for Hologres AI nodes
parameters.help_zh: 服务副本数，此参数仅 Hologres AI 节点需要
parameters.name: service_count

parameters.help_en: The model type, such as chat/completions or embedding. Refer to the types returned by ListModelCatalog and create the model as needed
parameters.help_zh: 模型类型，比如chat/completions，embedding。请参考ListModelCatalog返回的类型，按需创建
parameters.name: task_type

data.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values: true: Successful. false: Failed
